Before you join others

Guild Hall code of conduct

This preview has no server: it simulates a crowd of visitors inside your browser so you can see seating, chat and avatars at scale. Nothing is sent anywhere.

  • Be kind and respectful. Harassment, hate, and unwanted contact are not welcome here.
  • Respect personal space. Anyone who walks into you fades out; you can mute or block anyone.
  • Your mic stays off until you press Mic. Voice is carried by LiveKit Cloud and is not recorded by this world.
  • Others will see your display name, avatar, position, and seat while you are connected. No gaze, hand, or device data is shared.
  • Read the XR Guild principles ↗.
